summary: This study tested a dietary supplement made of cranberry extracts and helpful bacteria called lactobacilli to see if it is feasible for women with type 2 diabetes who often get urinary tract infections, which are infections in the urinary system. A total of 100 participants took the oral supplement for 60 days and were followed for a total of 180 days. The trial was sponsored by the National Institute of Endocrinology, Georgia.
